title: CDC: FASTCDC metadata with CDC_MAP TLV
description: SAR archive with CDC_SUPPORT flag, FASTCDC algorithm (ID 0x02), and a CDC_MAP TLV. Validates CDC map parse/write and structural CDC map validation. Note: this vector does NOT claim FASTCDC boundary-regeneration interoperability; the CDC_MAP is treated as an authoritative chunk record.
notes: No FASTCDC boundary-regeneration conformance claim is made for this vector.
The CDC_MAP is treated as an authoritative self-describing record.
